verdict.rationale: Box's developer guides document an API search capability that finds content using full-text search queries, so search goes beyond prefix matching into file content. The evidence is a single summary line, though, and it never explicitly mentions filename matching or query options. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of filename search alongside content search, endpoint/parameter detail (scoping, filters, content types indexed), independent or hands-on corroboration of full-text search quality.

support.subject: As a developer, search reaches inside files — a documented search API over filenames and full-text content, not just prefix matching

citations.quote: The Box API provides a way to find content in Box using full-text search queries.
API requests use the base URL `https://api.box.com/2.0` and require an OAuth 2.0 access token
